privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Nexa ("we", "us") respects the privacy of our users. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it when you use our online store.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you browse the store, shop, or create an account, we may collect: your name and email address, shipping address and payment details (processed securely by Stripe), cart contents, order history, and technical information such as your IP address and cookie data.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use the data we collect to process orders, maintain your account, improve our products and services, communicate with you (e.g. order confirmations), and comply with our legal obligations.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Nexa uses cookies for core site functionality (e.g. remembering your cart contents and chosen language) and for traffic analysis. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Third parties
sections.body: To provide our services, we share data with trusted providers: Supabase (database, hosting, and authentication) and Stripe (payment processing). Each of them processes data according to their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Storage and security
sections.body: Your data is stored on secure servers, and access to it is restricted. We keep personal information for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, as well as to withdraw your consent to data processing at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you via the site or by email.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at privacy@nexa-shop.example.

aboutPage.heading: Shopping, built with you in mind
aboutPage.subtitle: Nexa is an online store that brings quality products from many categories together in one place — with a clean design, fast shopping, and attention to detail.
aboutPage.storyBody1: Nexa started with a simple idea — shopping online shouldn't be complicated. We wanted to build a store where finding the right product takes seconds, not minutes, and the path from browsing to checkout feels smooth and enjoyable.
aboutPage.storyBody2: Today we bring together products across electronics, fashion, home, and accessories — curated, categorized, and presented in a way that makes choosing easy.
aboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Browse the full catalog and find the products you're looking for.
